en: The image depicts a historical town square with a prominent clock tower building in the center, surrounded by other old-style buildings. There are horse-drawn carriages and people in period clothing, indicating an early 20th-century or late 19th-century setting. The sky is clear with a gradient of blue to light orange. The postcard is captioned in three languages: Hungarian (Brassó), German (Kronstadt), and Romanian (Brașov), along with the words Tanácsház (Hungarian for 'town hall') and Rathaus (German for 'town hall').
